summary: Makes transformed copies of an input POP, optionally placing copies at each point of a second template POP. Copy and template attributes can drive transform, identity, and output attribute composition.

key_params.name: ncy
key_params.note: Number of copies, or copies per template point when templated

key_params.name: copyidname
key_params.note: Name of the generated CopyId attribute

key_params.name: forwarddir
key_params.note: Forward direction used by look-at orientation

key_params.name: vlength
key_params.note: Vector length used by look-at orientation

key_params.name: dimension
key_params.note: How copied output affects POP dimension metadata

key_params.name: dotemplatematrix
key_params.note: Apply transform matrices from template points

key_concepts: Copy POP creates repeated transformed copies, with numeric copies using cumulative transforms from one copy to the next.
When a template POP is connected, template points and attributes can drive per-copy transforms, translations, orientation, identity, and output attributes.
CopyId, dimension metadata, look-at orientation, template matrices, and template translations are the main controls for keeping copied geometry addressable downstream.
common_gotchas: Transforms for numeric copies are cumulative; the first copy has no transform and later copies build from the prior one.
When a template input is connected, copy count is multiplied per template point.
Copy POP can increase POP dimension metadata; validate dimension-sensitive downstream logic.
